name: @allw/example-walking-skeleton
description: v0 walking-skeleton demo + integration harness: composes @allw/sdk, @allw/approver, and @allw/hook end-to-end (no crypto of its own).

scripts.build:deps: pnpm --filter @allw/sdk build && pnpm --filter @allw/approver build && pnpm --filter @allw/hook build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:deps && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs"
